corrections.reason: Visually in Col 1 L17, the printed word is ዳስ ('booth/trellis' made for a vine: ዳስ ሠርተውለት ያፈራል), which was misread as ጻዕ.
The top ring of ቶ in በመቶ በመቶ ('by the hundreds', referring to ቃዳ jars of wine) was misread as 6th-order ት.
Following አንዳንድ ቃዳ እያከለ ይሄዳል, the commentary continues እየቀዳም የምትሰሩ ('and pouring it out...'), with 4th-order ዳ clearly visible on the page.
The printed word is እጽቅ ('branch', translating እጽቅ in L03), where ink bleed on እ and ቅ caused Stage 1 to misread it as ጸጽቀ.
